svg.title: How a backreference runs out of input part way
svg.desc: ^(abc)-\1: \1 is rewritten as (?:\1|(?!\1)(?![\s\S]{3})(?=([\s\S]+))(?<=(?=\1)([\s\S]*?))(?<=(?=\H)\G)\H|$(?![\s\S])(?!\1)). On "abc-ab", the rest of the input, "ab", is captured, the nearest occurrence of "abc" before it is found at 0, and "ab" starts that occurrence, so the input matches partially. On "abc-ax", the same steps find "ax" doesn't start it, the input hasn't ended, and the match fails.
